info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Aerospace and Systems Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程主教授彈性介質中體波與表面波的波傳分析。課程內容包括-彈性力學複習、一維波動、彈性體之波動方程式、無限介質之平面波傳、二維波動、藍姆波、集中力之波動、障礙物之散射與繞射。
description.describe_eh: This course provides the students with a theoretical background about body waves and surface waves excitation and propagation in elastic media.  The main topics include introduction to linear elasticity, one-dimensional waves, field equation of linear elastodynamics, plane waves in unbounded media, two-dimensional problem, Lamb waves, concentrated forced, scattering and diffraction by obstacles.

targets.describe_ch: 傳授波動力學中必要之彈性力學及應力與應變關係之基礎知識。
targets.describe_en: Give the graduate students the necessary theoretical background in elasticity and the stress-strain relation.

targets.describe_ch: 使學生明瞭彈性波的基本理論與波動方程式的推導與應用。
targets.describe_en: Introduce the participants to the basic theory of elastic waves and the derivation of equation of motion.

targets.describe_ch: 使學生明瞭體波與表面波在各種材料的傳播與超音波非破壞檢測之應用。
targets.describe_en: Provide the student with a theoretical background about body waves and surface waves excitation and propagation in elastic media and the application to ultrasonic nondestructive evaluation.

targets.describe_ch: 具口頭報告與分析相關主題之能力
targets.describe_en: To be capable of making a fine presentation of their analysis works

targets.describe_ch: 具團隊合作精神以進行工程分析之能力
targets.describe_en: To work as a team member to pursue analysis of engineering applications
